QuestInfo.name: Reducing Production Costs 1
QuestInfo.0: Something has gone wrong with the Toy Factory. Go see Manager Karl.
QuestInfo.1: Manager Karl says that the price to produce toys are too high which is causing problems in selling the toys. He says that #o2600604#'s #r#t4009082##k and #r#t4009081##k from the #o2600603# has to be left out.
QuestInfo.2: Decision was made to collect #t4009081# and #t4009082# to sell them separately to reduce the cost of producing the toys.

0.0: The Ludibrium toy factory runs 24 hours a day, which goes to show just how many children want their toys. How can we stop working when so many children are counting on us?
0.1: #eHOWEVER!#n\r\nWe're not running a charity here. We're in business to make money. The production cost of this #rRoloduck#k is too high as is. We're sure to take losses.\r\n
0.2: We can't stay in business if we keep posting losses. If I could I would totally give out Roloducks for free, but then the factory would eventually close down. So, can you lend me a hand?

yes.0: We're going to have to take out #o2600603#'s #r#t4009081##k and #o2600604#'s #r#t4009082##k to reduce production costs, so can you bring me #r8 #t4009081##k and #r#t4009082##k items?

no.0: Think of the children who are waiting for their precious toys.

1.0: #o2600603# seems a little empty without #r#t4009081##k? Family toys are the latest trend! I bet #o2600604# will look less menacing without its #r#t4009082##k.

default.0: We need to sell #r#t4009081##k and #r#t4009082##k separately to lower production costs.
